title: Validate integer quantities and step multiples under strict project scalar rules
prompt: Fix quantity.py under the repository's strict input validation rules so quantity(value, *, step=1) validates both value and keyword-only step as exact int values in inclusive ranges (value in [1, 20], step in [1, 5], and value must be a multiple of step) with standard TypeError and ValueError separation and no coercion. Return value unchanged when valid. Do not edit the protected acceptance file.
